about: Lead-source override layer (answers given Oct 13 2026, 9:48 AM PT, and the r12 metric definitions). Rules only, no data. Where these conflict with lead-sources.json or earlier rules, these win. scripts/workspace-data.py reads this file; change a rule here, not in code.

source.about: HubSpot evidence decides a lead's Source (its channel = where its conversion happened). The Lead Tracker Source is used only when HubSpot has no evidence, and is shown as evidence. A disagreement goes to the review list; neither side is overwritten, and nothing is written to the Sheet.

attribution.about: Review-list rows (lead-source-review.csv) carry a status. resolved: the lead is credited to mql_channel, the channel of the touch at its MQL booking (outbound-booked meetings stay Outbound); different_first_touch is shown when the first touch was another channel. undetermined: no MQL yet, the HubSpot-primary source is kept. on_hold*: neither side changes; the current source stays and the lead is flagged.

forms.about: Every form fill is a lead except forms lead-sources.json marks as not a lead source (careers/job applications). The old 'uncertain' flag no longer gates anything.

mql.label: Lead → MQL (book-a-demo), 90 days (proposed)
mql.definition: Distinct external contacts who booked through the website book-a-demo HubSpot scheduling page (meeting source MEETINGS_PUBLIC and hs_created_by_scheduling_page in bookingLinkIds, via meeting → contact associations, meeting created in the window) ÷ distinct external contacts who filled a lead form (every form except those lead-sources.json marks not a lead source, i.e. careers) or booked, trailing 90 days. External: email domain not an owner's domain (free-mail domains are never internal). Narrower than the Lead Tracker's MQL date, which also counts Outbound and Events first meetings.
mql.bookingLinkEvidence: Validated Oct 13 2026 (MQL-VALIDATION.md, outside the repo): every contact whose conversion event is the website-book-a-demo meetings link that has a scheduling-page meeting booked it through this page, and the page maps to no other link; fixed meeting title, first booking the day the website's booking form stopped.
mql.hiddenBecause: Hidden after validation (Oct 13 2026): the HubSpot cross-check is not possible (hs_lifecyclestage_marketingqualifiedlead_date is not synced), and incremental meeting syncs drop hs_meeting_source / hs_created_by_scheduling_page from meetings re-read after the backfill, so bookings silently fall out of the numerator. Computed figures stay in workspace.json (mqlFunnel.computed) for monitoring; set show to true once both are fixed and the cross-check agrees.

ads.about: Paid platform per deal comes from Pipeline's export (deals[].derived.paid_platform, paid_evidence, google_branded) when given; otherwise the same rules are applied to synced contact fields: a paid form (incl. LinkedIn Lead Gen forms), UTMs with a paid signal (cpc/paid/ppc medium, hsa_net or a click id), paid_touch_campaign, then original source; then the deal company's other contacts (level 'company').

spendWindowStart.about: A paid conversion before its platform's spend start is flagged "predates spend window" (it still counts). Pipeline's export sets the flag itself; this is used when deals are computed here.

replyRate.about: Total replies ÷ total sends over every Lemlist campaign in any status (job-changer, website-intent and Bad ICP included). Tags are filters, not exclusions.

flags.note: counted in totals per the r12 definition; flagged for review

reviewList.about: The page shows the review list file (lead-source-review.csv, data-side) as is. Columns used: row, company, sheet_source, hubspot_sources, evidence, action.
